technical.summary: Short-term momentum is strong with RSI9 extreme overbought and golden cross, but price remains below key long-term moving averages and Ichimoku cloud, creating pullback risk despite bullish short-term technicals.

fundamental.summary: DOC shows no fundamental conviction signals—zero insider activity, no institutional positioning, no government contracts, no lobbying spend, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 98 days present elevated risk.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals with fear-zone contrarian opportunity offset by minimal congressional conviction and absent news confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession, VIX at crisis levels (280), FOMC event in 1 day creates binary risk, and real estate sector faces credit stress in tightening environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI9 extreme overbought + EMA 9/21 golden cross + Awesome Oscillator cross-up signal strong short-term momentum in a fear-zone contrarian opportunity window.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below EMA50 and SMA200 with Ichimoku below cloud, zero fundamental conviction, earnings risk in 98 days, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, and FOMC event in 1 day create compounding macro and technical headwinds that outweigh momentum signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum (RSI9 overbought, golden cross, AO cross-up) offers contrarian entry at support in fear-zone environment. However, macro headwinds and fundamental vacuum eliminate conviction despite technical setup.
decision.primary_risk: FOMC event in 1 day creates binary volatility risk; inverted yield curve and VIX crisis levels signal recession environment hostile to real estate; earnings in 98 days add uncertainty.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Already 26 positions in Real Estate sector; adding DOC increases concentration risk in macro-challenged asset class without fundamental justification.
